notes: The control panel uses high-contrast vector lettering with correctly oriented Program 1–5, Menu/Enter, Start/Stop, Short, arrows, and readable time/temperature/speed fields. All 18 marked controls have independent collision caps and spring-return slide joints (6 mm travel); labels move with their keys. This adds physical pressability, not new machine operating modes or dynamic display values. Program 1 retains its grading joint name and ordered single-press requirement. The 24 physical wells, 60-well rack, tubes, friction caps, randomization and task rubric are retained. Recorded contact-test fixtures were migrated by joint/body identity to include the 16 new button joints; historical episodes require their original scene snapshots.
